title: androsace occidentalis var. simplex
intro: Androsace occidentalis var. simplex, commonly known as Western Rock Jasmine, is a flowering plant species in the Primulaceae family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help to protect against cell damage and promote overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Western Rock Jasmine include its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce stress, and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and health benefits.
